buildings.caveats: Unlocks science and scholar. Later data-center stage is a different contract.

buildings.name: 花间食圃
buildings.caveats: Demand reductions use limited diminishing returns. Later solar stage replaces effects.

buildings.name: 林泉水渠
buildings.caveats: Later hydroelectric stage replaces effects.

buildings.name: 观星台
buildings.caveats: Science capacity becomes1500 with astrolabe; other observatory upgrades multiply both science effects.

buildings.name: 花木实验室
buildings.caveats: Additional capacity, biofuel and energy effects require calculation; not fully specified.

buildings.name: 工料库
buildings.caveats: No honey capacity initially; silos adds750. Later spaceport stage separate.

buildings.name: 河湾港
buildings.caveats: Cargo-ship and storage upgrades modify capacities.

buildings.name: 石矿井
buildings.caveats: Unlocks miner. DeepMining adds .003coal/tick; ecology enables toggle.

buildings.name: 山岩采场
buildings.caveats: OrbitalGeodesy adds .0005uranium/tick.

buildings.name: 铸铁炉
buildings.caveats: GoldOre adds .001gold/tick; CoalFurnace .005coal/tick; NuclearSmelters .0015titanium/tick; insufficient inputs throttle all outputs.

buildings.name: 焙烧炉
buildings.caveats: Upgrades alter iron and titanium with different multipliers; optional steel conversion separate.

buildings.name: 蒸汽工坊
buildings.caveats: Coal penalty is a single enabled-system multiplier, not -.8 per building. PrintingPress .0005manuscript/tick each; successive press upgrades multiply4 each.

buildings.name: 林原发电机
buildings.caveats: Excludes honey and direct oil bonus; steamworks boost this production effect.

buildings.name: 木材工场
buildings.caveats: Saw bonuses modify .1 by1+sawBonus.

buildings.name: 深林油井
buildings.caveats: Pumpjack and extraction upgrades require further dynamic rules.

buildings.name: 精工厂
buildings.caveats: Engineer slots, energy, pollution and environmental modifiers require dynamic rules.

buildings.name: 晶能反应堆
buildings.caveats: Excludes honey/uranium production bonus; supply shortages disable.

buildings.name: 微粒加速环
buildings.caveats: Storage upgrades and LHC science capacity are additional.

buildings.name: 林间驿站
buildings.caveats: Caravanserai adds .0035standing each.

buildings.name: 林币铸坊
buildings.caveats: Actual fur/ivory output also depends on manpower capacity; do not treat listed baseline as complete output formula.

buildings.name: 山谷剧场
buildings.caveats: Later broadcast stage separate.

buildings.name: 花灯祈堂
buildings.caveats: Atheism removes faith; frescoes adds karma-dependent faith capacity.

buildings.name: 山灵神殿
buildings.caveats: Theology adds .0015faith/tick. Many religion upgrades add effects; atheism radically changes this building.

buildings.name: 灵鹿花苑
buildings.caveats: Unicorn tears challenge adds capacity restriction.

buildings.name: 叠石祭坛
buildings.caveats: Enables mythic-faith branch; sacrifice tears output scales with count.

buildings.name: 森智核心
buildings.caveats: Total power at n active units is n×(3n+5)/4; special AI level/sale restrictions.

buildings.name: 蜜酿坊
buildings.caveats: Input shortage throttles all benefits;opensdarkBrew special upgrade.

buildings.name: 条纹前哨
buildings.caveats: Source zebraRequired5 metadata has no JS consumer found; do not invent enforcement. DarkRevolution preparations1IronWill or.1normal, modified bypreparationRatio.

buildings.name: 条纹工房
buildings.caveats: OpensdarkRevolution. zebraRequired10 appears unused. BloodstoneInstitute production formula requires detailed special-upgrade implementation.

buildings.name: 条纹熔炉
buildings.caveats: Opensbloodstone/tMythrilrecipes+whispers. zebraRequired50 appears unused. ReforgedOutposts totalpreparationRatio=floor(count/10);Rangefinders+.01bloodstoneRatio each.

buildings.name: 条纹休眠舱
buildings.caveats: If zebraCap<10 replace1tMythril with100eludium. zebraRequired1 appears unused.

buildings.name: 白枝研磨堂
buildings.caveats: Visible at10%first costs. Whispers automation replaces conversion with200ivory+2titanium+.00002alicorn→2minerals+.00005tMythril per tick; shortage throttle.
